Annotation tracks: bed-like features from a data.frame, GRanges or UCSCData

Source: R/tracks.R
igvAnnotationTrack-class.Rd

igvAnnotationTrack adds the slots of igv.js annotation tracks to Track. Its subclasses carry the features in a coreObject slot: DataFrameAnnotationTrack (a bed-like data.frame, written as is), GRangesAnnotationTrack (a GRanges; 1-based starts become 0-based bed starts) and UCSCBedAnnotationTrack (an rtracklayer UCSCData, needs the suggested package rtracklayer). Display one with loadTrack, which sends displayMode, expandedRowHeight, squishedRowHeight, maxRows, searchable and visibilityWindow to igv.js. nameField is stored for igvR compatibility, not sent.

Usage

DataFrameAnnotationTrack(
  trackName,
  annotation,
  color = "",
  displayMode = "SQUISHED",
  trackHeight = 50,
  expandedRowHeight = 30,
  squishedRowHeight = 15,
  maxRows = 500,
  searchable = FALSE,
  visibilityWindow = 1e+05
)

GRangesAnnotationTrack(
  trackName,
  annotationData,
  color = "darkGrey",
  displayMode = "SQUISHED",
  trackHeight = 50,
  expandedRowHeight = 30,
  squishedRowHeight = 15,
  maxRows = 500,
  searchable = FALSE,
  visibilityWindow = 1e+05
)

UCSCBedAnnotationTrack(
  trackName,
  annotation,
  color = "darkGrey",
  displayMode = "SQUISHED",
  trackHeight = 50,
  expandedRowHeight = 30,
  squishedRowHeight = 15,
  maxRows = 500,
  searchable = FALSE,
  visibilityWindow = 1e+05
)

Arguments

trackName

A character string, used as track label by igv; we recommend unique names per track

annotation

for DataFrameAnnotationTrack, a data.frame with at least chrom (or chr), start and end columns, in bed (0-based) coordinates; for UCSCBedAnnotationTrack, a UCSCData object, e.g. from rtracklayer::import(format = "bed")

color

A CSS color name (e.g., "red" or "#FF0000"), or "random"; for a data.frame, leave the default "" if supplying bed9 with itemRgb

displayMode

"COLLAPSED", "SQUISHED" or "EXPANDED"

trackHeight

track height in pixels

expandedRowHeight

Height of each row of features in "EXPANDED" mode

squishedRowHeight

Height of each row of features in "SQUISHED" mode

maxRows

maximum number of feature rows to display

searchable

If TRUE, labels on annotation elements may be used in search

visibilityWindow

Maximum window size in base pairs for which features are displayed

annotationData

a GRanges; mcols "name" and "score", when present, fill the bed name and score columns

Value

An object of the named class

Slots

classTypeOfSuppliedObject

character

displayMode

character, "COLLAPSED", "SQUISHED" or "EXPANDED"

expandedRowHeight

numeric, row height in "EXPANDED" mode

squishedRowHeight

numeric, row height in "SQUISHED" mode

nameField

character; stored for igvR compatibility, not sent

maxRows

numeric

searchable

logical

coreObject

the features: data.frame, GRanges or UCSCData

Examples

tbl <- data.frame(chrom = rep("chr5", 3),
                  start = c(88883100, 88883200, 88883350),
                  end = c(88883150, 88883220, 88883390),
                  name = c("a", "b", "c"),
                  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
track <- DataFrameAnnotationTrack("data.frame demo", tbl, color = "red")
gr <- GenomicRanges::GRanges(c("chr5:100-149", "chr5:300-349"))
track2 <- GRangesAnnotationTrack("GRanges demo", gr)
trackSize(track2)
#> [1] 2
